services.name: Lewes DE Fishing
services.desc: We offer a family friendly Delaware Bay Bottom And Wreck Fishing Trip that is sure to please everyone. With a short ride to the fishing grounds we can catch a variety of fish, this is a great fishing trip for family's and young children. The MandaLu offers multiple Lewes DE Ocean Fishing Trips, anywhere from 4 - 12 Hours - We can custimize a trip for you. We offer a 4 hour Lewes DE Shark Fishing Trips, Fishing for Sand Tiger Sharks up to 9' in length and other shark species. With a 30 to 40 minute ride to the fishing grounds this is a great trip for the adventurous
